prohibited.item: score, rating, rank, percentile, BARS label, behavioral_score, readiness_score, ordinal_anchor
prohibited.reason: Scoring is retired; nothing reintroduces scores, ratings or scales
prohibited.use_instead: Determinations, state_code and Recorded Conduct Entries

prohibited.item: level_1 to level_4, observation_level, L1 to L4
tier, band, Silver, Gold, Platinum, match or matching value, BehaviourMatch
prohibited.reason: Tier logic and matching are retired

prohibited.reason: Retired outright; historical rows read only

escalate as a progression state
validation_status or any identifier containing validate
fingerprint in any identifier
dimensions_flagged, dimension_scores
ai_score_override, ai_assist_notes_accepted, ai_assist_notes_ignored, any AI suggestion to a mentor
prohibited.reason: No AI suggestion or auto selection exists

prohibited.item: free text mentor conclusion, evidence_notes as free text, decision rationale as free text
prohibited.reason: Free text never reaches the record

accommodation reason, diagnosis or medical detail

mood, personality, trait, character, potential or risk label
predicted performance, retention, probation or success fields
hire, reject, still employed, probation outcome, rehire intention, performance rating linked to a participant

social media or public record scraping fields
shortlist or exclusion flag; governance.tier_change; mentor.override_requested for a fourth attempt
any shared table, template, name or data path between the Behavioral Evidence Report and an employer commissioned competence record

acceptance_tests.steps: Run tools/check_dictionary.py, load every atomic row of the JSON into the field registry, then for every ACTIVE and DORMANT qualified_name query the physical schema map
acceptance_tests.expected: Checker passes; every qualified_name resolves to exactly one column or governed payload key and its capture_state column where required; zero unmapped

acceptance_tests.steps: Run tools/check_forbidden_identifiers.py over the repository with exact exclusions only and --manifest
acceptance_tests.expected: Zero hits outside the excluded paths; every approved wording carries a t3a-allow marker and appears in the manifest allowances; the scanned file manifest is delivered; any hit fails the build

acceptance_tests.steps: POST sign up with role_code=mentor in the body
acceptance_tests.expected: Account created as participant only, or refused; event logged; no mentor role row

acceptance_tests.steps: Create participant, do not verify, call mentor request, release and Stage entry endpoints
acceptance_tests.expected: All refuse with a stated reason; observation cannot be recorded

acceptance_tests.steps: Submit one consent interaction carrying two consent_type values
acceptance_tests.expected: Refused; no consent row written

acceptance_tests.steps: Grant mentor_observation scoped to D1; attempt D2 Stage entry
acceptance_tests.expected: Stage entry refuses for want of D2 consent

acceptance_tests.steps: Withdraw scenario_logging after one committed observation
acceptance_tests.expected: Earlier observation still readable in history; new capture refuses; consent.withdrawn event present

acceptance_tests.steps: Attempt to capture followup_contact and aggregate_regional
acceptance_tests.expected: Refused and logged; no row

acceptance_tests.steps: Create participant with no lsa consent text loaded
acceptance_tests.expected: lsa_consent_state = never_asked; no prompt rendered; empty socket logged

acceptance_tests.steps: Attempt Stage entry with no observation_path_gateway
acceptance_tests.expected: Refused

acceptance_tests.steps: Allocate mentor, wait, then enter Stage
acceptance_tests.expected: stage_entry_event created at the entry action, not at allocation

acceptance_tests.steps: Run three attempts, reset any counter through every admin route
acceptance_tests.expected: attempt_no never decreases; fourth counted attempt refuses under the loaded rule

acceptance_tests.steps: Record welfare stop
acceptance_tests.expected: attempt_counted=false; no cooldown

acceptance_tests.steps: Commit an observation whose source lacks comparison fields
acceptance_tests.expected: Commit succeeds; comparison fields capture_state = not_authored; longitudinal_use_status = not_eligible

acceptance_tests.steps: Commit an S2 observation with no observer_id
acceptance_tests.expected: Refused; the refusal is logged with its reason

acceptance_tests.steps: Attempt to set observer_id on an S1 record
acceptance_tests.expected: Refused; confirmer fields used instead

acceptance_tests.steps: Commit any observation
acceptance_tests.expected: Both source_version_hash and rendered_instance_hash present and different objects

acceptance_tests.steps: Open S1 output from the S2 mentor session before lock
acceptance_tests.expected: Refused; after s2_determinations_locked_at the output opens and s1_output_unmasked_at is written

acceptance_tests.steps: Attempt S2 entry before s1_outcome_delivered_to_mentor_at
acceptance_tests.expected: Refused

acceptance_tests.steps: Post a free text conclusion or rationale to any mentor endpoint
acceptance_tests.expected: Refused; only controlled codes accepted

acceptance_tests.steps: Post any accommodation reason text
acceptance_tests.expected: Refused; only accommodation_class stored

acceptance_tests.steps: Issue UPDATE and DELETE against observation, determination and event tables through the application and a direct database role
acceptance_tests.expected: Both refused; correction possible only by superseding record

acceptance_tests.steps: Emit every ACTIVE catalog event once and validate each with tools/check_records.py event
acceptance_tests.expected: Each passes: envelope fields valid, required keys present, conditional keys honored, no key outside required and optional, every value in its registered format, payload at most 4096 bytes, no personal or free text keys, occurred_at not later than ingested_at, previous_hash present after the first event of a stream

acceptance_tests.steps: Emit an event not in the registry
